checks.title: Effect is specific to K4 (skip_checks); no association for K2 (scorer edit)
checks.evidence:
Setup: I rebuilt the part-A rows independently. The script /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-mauricio-Desktop-Uni-Master-1-Semester-Hackathon-apart/6b604ad8-2b8f-4c9b-91f6-20738eb16ec2/scratchpad/verify/confirm-contagion-confounding/build_rows.py copies the row logic of contagion.py 1:1 and adds params.category and params.channels. The '-K4-' name tag agrees with params.category in all 112 configs. The pooled run reproduces the deliverable: 152,705 rows, 1,321 adoptions, E_dir 2.34 [1.54; 3.57], dm>0 2.02 [1.19; 3.61].

Numbers: every figure the reviewer quotes reproduces exactly (/private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-mauricio-Desktop-Uni-Master-1-Semester-Hackathon-apart/6b604ad8-2b8f-4c9b-91f6-20738eb16ec2/scratchpad/verify/confirm-contagion-confounding/mh_sub_w3.txt):
- K2: E_dir 0.87 [0.52; 1.34] (24 configs, 29 exposed adoptions); dm>0 1.04 [0.46; 2.60]; E_mech 0.80 [0.47; 1.38].
- K4: E_dir 3.99 [2.39; 6.98]; dm>0 2.65 [1.35; 5.79]; placebo dm>0 0.74 [0.55; 1.03].
- Windows (/private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-mauricio-Desktop-Uni-Master-1-Semester-Hackathon-apart/6b604ad8-2b8f-4c9b-91f6-20738eb16ec2/scratchpad/verify/confirm-contagion-confounding/windows.txt): K2 at w=1 0.78 [0.27; 1.49], at w=5 1.34 [0.79; 2.07].

The heterogeneity is real for the headline estimate (/private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-mauricio-Desktop-Uni-Master-1-Semester-Hackathon-apart/6b604ad8-2b8f-4c9b-91f6-20738eb16ec2/scratchpad/verify/confirm-contagion-confounding/contrasts_w3.txt; joint config bootstrap plus 10,000 config-label permutations):
- K4/K2 ratio 4.60 [2.30; 9.76], permutation p=0.0004 (0.0003 when permuting within channel). E_mech ratio 7.42 [3.24; 19.0].
- My own conditional logit uses a different covariate set: model, persona, role, flags, difficulty, DM degree, number of DMs, broadcast edge from a violator, any private DM, and a ticket-graph neighbour who already violated (/private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-mauricio-Desktop-Uni-Master-1-Semester-Hackathon-apart/6b604ad8-2b8f-4c9b-91f6-20738eb16ec2/scratchpad/verify/confirm-contagion-confounding/clr_own_w3.txt). It gives K2 0.98 [0.50; 1.72] and K4 2.27 [1.39; 3.70].
- Not an artifact of how adoption is counted: dropping the 15 K2 agents whose check another agent quarantined (they never violated themselves) gives K2 0.96 [0.61; 1.48] (/private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-mauricio-Desktop-Uni-Master-1-Semester-Hackathon-apart/6b604ad8-2b8f-4c9b-91f6-20738eb16ec2/scratchpad/verify/confirm-contagion-confounding/mh_noproxy.txt).

What does NOT hold:
(a) In the primary specification of ANALYSIS_PLAN §4 (dm>0), the K4–K2 difference is not significant: ratio 2.56 [0.83; 7.82], permutation p=0.11. In that specification the K2 interval includes 2 in every variant: MH 1.04 [0.46; 2.60], my conditional logit 1.61 [0.62; 4.87], w=5 1.62 [0.81; 3.31]. So for the primary estimate K2 is uninformative, not shown to be null. 'Does not hold for half the batch' is only true for the all-rows 2.34.
(b) The K2 null comes from K2 swarms on the board: 0.55 [0.28; 0.82], covering 18 of the 24 informative K2 configs. Off the board, K2 is strongly positive: 7.80 [3.87; 16.07] (thin: 6 configs, 7 exposed adoptions; 13.4 at w=5). Within the board the category gap remains: K4-board/K2-board 4.84 [2.62; 11.17], p=0.0001. So 'specific to K4' and 'restrict the claim to K4' mislabel the pattern.
(c) The suggested code has a precedence bug. `mh(DM == 1 & K4, x)` parses as `DM == (1 & K4)` and selects 77,543 rows instead of 16,646, including 60,897 K2 rows without any DM. The `~K4` variant has the same bug.
checks.fix:
Code (contagion.py):
- Append `sc["params"]["category"][:2], sc["params"]["channels"]` to each row.
- Keep the matrix numeric: `A = np.array([r[2:11] for r in rows], dtype=float)`, then `CAT = np.array([r[11] for r in rows])` and `CH = np.array([r[12] for r in rows])`.
- For each group g in K2, K4, K2&board, K4&board, K2&non-board, K4&non-board, and each k in E_dir, E_mech, P_dir, add `summarize(mh(g, X[k]))` and `summarize(mh(g & (DM == 1), X[k]))` next to the pooled rows. The parentheses around `DM == 1` are required.

Text (contagion.md and FINDINGS): keep the pooled 2.34 / 2.02 as an average and add: 'K4: 3,99 [2,39; 6,98] (nur Agenten mit Direktnachrichten 2,65 [1,35; 5,79]); K2: 0,87 [0,52; 1,34] (1,04 [0,46; 2,60]), kein Hinweis auf einen Zusammenhang. Der K2-Nullbefund kommt von den K2-Boards (0,55 [0,28; 0,82]); in den wenigen K2-Team-/DM-Schwärmen ist er positiv (7,8; nur 6 Konfigs). Unterschied K4/K2: 4,6 [2,3; 9,8], p < 0,001; unter Agenten mit Direktnachrichten 2,6 [0,8; 7,8], p = 0,11.'

Do not restrict the whole claim to K4.

checks.title: Pooled OR mixes very different channel settings; on the board the DM association equals the placebo
checks.evidence:
Numbers: all reproduce exactly (/private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-mauricio-Desktop-Uni-Master-1-Semester-Hackathon-apart/6b604ad8-2b8f-4c9b-91f6-20738eb16ec2/scratchpad/verify/confirm-contagion-confounding/mh_sub_w3.txt and /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-mauricio-Desktop-Uni-Master-1-Semester-Hackathon-apart/6b604ad8-2b8f-4c9b-91f6-20738eb16ec2/scratchpad/verify/confirm-contagion-confounding/contrasts_w3.txt):
- Board configs hold 980 of 1,321 adoptions.
- Board: E_dir 1.43 [0.97; 2.05] vs placebo 1.50 [1.19; 1.85]; dm>0 1.19 [0.63; 2.16] (placebo 1.00 [0.70; 1.52]).
- team_channels 5.10 [2.11; 13.65]; dm_only 29.90 [7.70; 82.47]; non-board/board ratio 5.65 [2.12; 16.38].
- K2-board E_dir 0.55 [0.28; 0.82].
- The private-DM figures reproduce only under the reviewer's definition, 'privately exposed vs completely unexposed' (/private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-mauricio-Desktop-Uni-Master-1-Semester-Hackathon-apart/6b604ad8-2b8f-4c9b-91f6-20738eb16ec2/scratchpad/verify/confirm-contagion-confounding/privonly_w3.txt): K2-board 0.42 [0.14; 0.79] (only 6 exposed adoptions), K4-board 3.77 [1.46; 13.44].

Tests:
- Non-board/board: permutation p=0.0001 (0.0002 within category). In dm>0 the ratio is 4.82 [1.59; 18.64], p=0.009.
- E_dir/P_dir ratio on the same board configs (joint bootstrap): 0.95 [0.61; 1.47] for all rows and 1.19 [0.63; 2.22] for dm>0. Off the board it is 6.92 [2.32; 20.1].
- My conditional logit: board 1.03 [0.69; 1.56] (placebo 1.12), non-board 4.52 [1.92; 14.64].

Why the board differs: take the comparison agents with no DM from a violator, in run-rounds where a violator was active. On the board, 63% (K2) and 76% (K4) of them already had a broadcast edge from a violator in the window. In team channels it is 12–18%, in dm_only 0%. So on the board the DM contrast only measures the extra effect of being addressed directly, on top of public exposure. That backs per-channel reporting.

Refinements:
- The board figure of about 1 averages two opposite cells. K2 boards are negative (0.55; conditional logit dm>0 0.32 [0.05; 0.57]). K4 boards are positive: MH 2.67 [1.74; 4.37], E_dir/P_dir 1.67 [1.02; 3.08] (dm>0 2.23 [1.17; 5.79]), conditional logit 1.52 [0.98; 2.48].
- So 'not separable from the placebo' holds for the board as a whole, but is only borderline for K4 boards.
- The K4-board private 3.77 has a private placebo of 2.14 [1.11; 4.26] in the same specification.
- The dm_only 29.9 comes entirely from 4 K4 configs; K2 dm_only has no informative strata.
checks.fix:
Code (contagion.py):
- Carry the channel setting per row and report MH rows for board, team_channels and dm_only, and for board × category.
- Each row should show E_dir and P_dir, for all rows and for dm>0, plus the E_dir/P_dir ratio per group (joint bootstrap over configs).
- Appending strings to `rows` breaks `np.array([r[2:] for r in rows], dtype=float)`; slice the numeric columns as `r[2:11]`.

Text (Lesart in contagion.md, FINDINGS lines 15–16 and 42–45): replace 'verdoppelt ungefähr die Chance' with: 'geht im Mittel mit etwa doppelt so häufigem Einstieg einher. Der Mittelwert mischt sehr verschiedene Kanäle: In Team-Kanal- und DM-Schwärmen ist der Zusammenhang groß (8,1 [3,4; 21,9]; Placebo 1,2). Auf dem gemeinsamen Board, wo 980 der 1.321 Einstiege liegen, ist er insgesamt vom Placebo nicht zu trennen (1,43 [0,97; 2,05] gegen 1,50 [1,19; 1,85]). Dort lesen die meisten Agenten die Posts der Verstoßer ohnehin; der Vergleich misst nur den Zusatz der direkten Ansprache. Innerhalb des Boards: K4 2,67 [1,74; 4,37], K2 0,55 [0,28; 0,82].'

Also qualify the placebo argument in FINDINGS ('echte Ansteckung'): it holds pooled and off the board, not for the board as a whole.
